messages.text:
Can you build Neon Pairs from the supplied product specification? Please implement the whole game, including its board codes, saved snapshots and replay command. Use the documented build and test commands and give me the offline dist/index.html. Keep the code arranged as the Architecture document says. If anything is unclear, ask me.

Read docs/README.md and the other documents in docs/ for this project's requirements.

Implemented Neon Pairs, including deterministic board codes, snapshot import/export, active-time game rules, saved preferences and best scores, and the replay CLI.

The offline build is ready: [dist/index.html](/work/dist/index.html)

Verification passed: `npm ci`, typecheck, 14 unit tests, the build, and all 6 browser journeys. The browser run used Playwright 1.64.1 and Chromium 156.0.8078.4. Keyboard accessibility-tree evidence is in [keyboard-accessibility-tree.yml](/work/evidence/keyboard-accessibility-tree.yml). A screen reader was not used.

Replay example: `npm run --silent replay -- test-fixtures/example.replay.json`
